'''Orchitoria''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Serrabloom]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Orchitoria never waits. On the battlefield, there is only one role worth playing: the proud queen who strikes first. Anyone bold enough to covet the crown gets dealt with."

Orchitoria is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A tall, pink, white, green, and blue orchid mantis with massive arms and an elegant, light green dress skirt behind its hind legs.

Orchitoria's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces pink with magenta, and green becomes aquamarine.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "If every [[Stalkerix]] needs 1 male to evolve into a [[Serrabloom]], then how many are needing to evolve it into an Orchitoria?"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Having mastered the dance of a lifetime, Orchitoria strikes with spellbinding elegance, enchanting all who witness her grace."
